name: finetune_osm

metrics.harness: Pooled IoU against 142 OpenStreetMap footprints in CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore - an AOI held out of training in full - plus scripts/eval_inria.py on 5 Inria val tiles

bangalore_vs_osm_at_0.50.note: Precision is ~0.49 for every model tested, which measures OpenStreetMap's incompleteness rather than model quality - roughly half of what any model predicts is not mapped.

limitations: Regresses Inria (0.639 vs the shipped 0.800) - fine-tuning on ~100 narrow tiles costs ~0.16 IoU regardless of label source. Joint training (kaggle_joint/) is the fix.
Positives come from OpenStreetMap, which is incomplete here; buildings nobody mapped were marked ignore only where the labeller had drawn an envelope over them.
Trained on two Indian cities; unvalidated anywhere else.
